revision.note: Explicit rebase to current game source. Render unchanged supplied asset-lab/exports/airlock-tunnel-v1/layer-inner-frame.svg as a transparent layer. Keep 1x1 footprint, 0.25 uniform scale and common anchor; use existing pressure cycle.

lineage.author: Codex
lineage.note: Enclosed 1x1 airlock at existing character scale. One shared geometry; graded shell visibility for outside, chamber and base-interior views. Visibility is independent of physical door interlock.

environment.renderer: Supplied native SVG; Sharp PNG export
